description: This file defines the 'Theme' model class within the OpenCart framework's admin module. It provides methods for creating, reading, updating, and deleting theme records in the database, as well as managing their statuses and retrieving theme lists.

classes.name: Theme
classes.description: Model class for managing theme records in the database within the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: addTheme
methods.description: Creates a new theme record in the database with provided data.

methods.name: editTheme
methods.description: Updates an existing theme record identified by theme_id with new data.

methods.name: editStatus
methods.description: Changes the status (enabled/disabled) of a specific theme record.

methods.name: deleteTheme
methods.description: Removes a theme record from the database based on theme_id.

methods.name: deleteThemesByStoreId
methods.description: Deletes all themes associated with a specific store identified by store_id.

methods.name: getTheme
methods.description: Retrieves a theme record by its primary key.

methods.name: getThemes
methods.description: Fetches a list of themes, with optional pagination.

methods.name: getTotalThemes
methods.description: Returns the total count of theme records in the database.
